=== Now listening ===
      Hosting starting
      Now listening on: http://localhost:5000
      Application started. Press Ctrl+C to shut down.
=== swagger ===
swagger: HTTP 200
=== openapi json ===
openapi: HTTP 404

observation.command: echo "=== Now listening ==="; grep -E "Now listening on|Application started|Hosting starting" /tmp/backend.log; echo "=== swagger ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 -o /dev/null -w "swagger: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:5000/swagger/index.html; echo "=== openapi json ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:5000/openapi/v1.json -o /tmp/openapi.json -w "openapi: HTTP %{http_code}\n"; head -c 200 /tmp/openapi.json
